decisions.reason: A rye country bread uses existing recipes and manual production at little extra cost, and its value is still uncertain, so the option is worth keeping.
The premium raisin stollen won a gold medal again and is the firm's flagship, so its value has largely resolved in its favour.
The seeded rye mixed bread costs little to carry alongside the existing bread range and has not shown poor results, so keeping the option is cheap.
The dark malt rye bread is a niche variant whose demand is still uncertain, but carrying it costs little, so it stays for now despite some overlap with other new rye breads.
The marzipan stollen is a seasonal item close to the core offer that complements the flagship stollen at low cost.
The ancient grain bread is the newest 'masterpiece' in a growing health-oriented segment, so its uncertain upside justifies keeping it.
